column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST, same shape as TestUninstallSchedulerBackupOnEveryDialect: one subtest per dialect via testutil.TestDB, so mysql and mssql call t.Skip in this PostgreSQL-only job (CLEAT_TEST_DB only) while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. cleat#2291, PR #2327: drives real Postgres, MySQL and SQL Server end to end to prove runDueBackups claims and advances a due backup_config exactly once. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_DB set: go test ./plugins/scheduledbackup/... -run TestRunDueBackupsDispatchesExactlyOnceAndAdvancesNextRunAt -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly mysql and mssql, postgres runs.
